headline_marked: [[Google rolls out Gemini Personalization]] and gesture updates to older Pixel Watches
headline: Google rolls out Gemini Personalization and gesture updates to older Pixel Watches
summary: The update brings Gemini Personalization to all older models, while expanded one-hand gestures and raise-to-talk improvements are specific to Pixel Watch 3 and 4.
details: Google is breathing new life into older Pixel Watches (2, 3, and 4) with a new software update, rolling out globally starting today. This update introduces clever, much-needed features to the wearables.

Gemini Personalization is a key feature coming to all older Pixel Watches, providing a more useful and connected assistant experience. It integrates data from services like Gmail, Calendar, Search, and Photos.
Expanded one-hand gestures will be available for Pixel Watch 3 and 4 owners. Additionally, the Pixel Watch 4 will receive improvements to its raise-to-talk functionality.

The update, identified as version CP3A.260905.002 (or .E1 for Pixel Watch 2), also includes general bug fixes and performance improvements. Users can check their watch settings for the latest software.

While features are somewhat fragmented across models due to hardware limitations, all watches are receiving some form of support. The Pixel Watch 2 is slated to reach its end of software support in October.

headline_marked: [[Microsoft announces Windows & Surface event]] for Oct 7, featuring local AI focus
headline: Microsoft announces Windows & Surface event for Oct 7, featuring local AI focus
summary: Microsoft will host its first major Windows event in over two years on October 7th in San Francisco, with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang joining Satya Nadella to discuss local AI's future on PC.
details: Microsoft will host a Windows and Surface event on October 7th in San Francisco. The company will discuss how local AI will shape the next chapter of the PC.
CEO Satya Nadella, Windows and Surface chief Pavan Davuluri, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang are confirmed attendees. Huang's presence suggests a strong focus on RTX Spark PCs.
Expectations include updates on Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra pricing and availability. Microsoft is also anticipated to highlight quality improvements to Windows, though Windows 12 is not expected.
This marks the first major Windows event in over two years, following the May 2024 unveiling of Arm-based Copilot Plus PCs and the June 2021 announcement of Windows 11.
